g.text: No sampler brings got closer to the ask than no remasking does
Every 95% interval crosses zero except least-likely 20%, which moves got further away. All sit 23 to 32 times above the 0.001 near-the-line bar.
Asks 4/24, 8/24, 16/24; 12/24 left out because it selects a different team population. Intervals resample teams within each cell and opponents across
arms. Win rate against the top-50 meta teams, behaviour-cloning policy on both sides, 3 seeds × 64 teams per ask.
